sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Secure User Authentication Foundation
epic_coverage: Infrastructure & DevOps, Backend Core, Mobile Foundation, Authentication
key_deliverables: VPC/DB/Compute CDK Stacks; Backend Skeleton; Mobile App Shell; Google/Apple Auth
demo_objectives: Show working login flow on mobile device connected to backend; Show deployed AWS resources
success_criteria: Users can log in and session is persisted; Cloud infrastructure is active and secure
risk_factors: Social Login configuration issues; AWS Quota limits
mitigation_strategies: Early manual testing of Auth flows; Check AWS quotas day 1

sprint_goal: Implement Core Library Management with Offline-First Synchronization
key_deliverables: Isar Local DB; Backend Sync API; User Service Logic; Sync Queue Schema
demo_objectives: Show data persisting offline; Show API responding to sync requests
success_criteria: Local DB schema matches Backend; Sync endpoints operational
risk_factors: Sync conflict resolution complexity; Schema mismatch
mitigation_strategies: Contract-first development for Sync API; Shared DTO definitions

sprint_goal: Deliver Premium Value via AI-Powered Recommendations and Full Sync
epic_coverage: Offline Sync, AI Recommendations, Core Features
key_deliverables: Background Sync Worker; RAG Pipeline; Library UI; Book Search
demo_objectives: Full offline-online sync cycle; AI Book recommendation generation
success_criteria: Sync works reliably in background; AI returns relevant results under 5s
risk_factors: AI Latency; Sync Worker battery usage; Sprint capacity maxed out
mitigation_strategies: Move Library UI to Sprint 4 if needed; Strict timeboxing on AI prompts
integration_windows: Day 7 for AI; Day 9 for Full Sync
